cover.workflow: FigFox Generate V2 → PNG → FigFox Skill native SVG reconstruction → scoped typography repair → exact native architecture group reuse → author-requested native SVG styling edits through FigFox Skill
cover.limitations: Editable substitute font and flat fills approximate generated typography. Reused architecture groups retain native geometry and embedded photo assets. Red selection frames are editorial illustrations.

architecture_art.method: Exact native group reuse, preserving descendants; remove only the original whole-architecture placement transforms and place the groups in local viewBox containers.
architecture_art.editorial_overlay: Red outer selection and nine red object-selection boxes with handles; hand-drawn rod arrow uses architecture greys #A9ADB3/#4A5056. FigFox wordmark is bright orange with subtle darker-orange hatching and black text depth; all other cover text is black. Pale purple dots are decorative. No decorative diagonal or horizontal lines.

text_palette.basis: Author requested bright orange only inside the FigFox wordmark, all other text black.

typography.wordmark: Original Arial bold restored; bright orange face, subtle darker-orange diagonal ink pattern and black offset depth layers.
typography.supporting_lines: Small black Arial Italic: Editable SVG / Reconstruct. Inspect. Repair.
typography.preview: PNG rendered locally with installed fonts; SVG retains native editable text and font fallbacks.
